parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Method 1: arrangements with E at each end minus those with all three Rs together: $7!/3!-5!$ (B1 for $7!/3!-e$ or ${}^7P_4-e$, where $e$ is a positive integer; M1 for $f-5!/r!$, where $f>120$ and $r=1$ or $2$), $=720$ (A1). If no marks scored, SC B1 for $840-120=720$. Method 2: arrangements with E at each end and no Rs together plus those with exactly two Rs together: ${5\choose3}\times4!+{4\choose1}\times5!$, or ${}^5P_3\times4!/3!+{}^5P_2\times4!$ (B1 for one of the four printed terms; M1 for $a\times4!+b\times5!$, $1\le a,b\le10$, or $c\times4!+d\times4!$, $1\le c,d\le20$), $240+480=720$ (A1). Total 3.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Method 1. Answer cases: group of 5, 3Rs2Es $=1$; 3Rs1E $={2\choose1}{4\choose1}=8$; 3Rs0Es $={4\choose2}=6$. Group of 4, 3Rs1E $={2\choose1}=2$; 3Rs0Es $={4\choose1}=4$. Marks: B1 for the correct number of ways for two correct identified scenarios other than 3Rs2Es; M1 for five correct identified scenarios added or correct; M1 for ${9\choose5}=126$ as denominator (accept ${9\choose4}$); A1 for $21/126=1/6=0.167$. Method 2. Answer: 3Rs in group of 5 ${6\choose2}=15$; 3Rs in group of 4 ${6\choose1}=6$. Marks: (B1) one correct case evaluated and linked; (M1) two correct scenarios added; (M1) denominator ${9\choose5}=126$ (accept ${9\choose4}$); (A1) $21/126=1/6=0.167$. Method 3. Answer: 3Rs in group of 5 $5\times4\times3/(9\times8\times7)=15/126$; 3Rs in group of 4 $4\times3\times2/(9\times8\times7)=6/126$. Marks: (B1) one correct unsimplified product linked to its scenario; (M1) second correct product; (M1) add two correct probabilities; (A1) $21/126=1/6=0.167$. Method 4. Answer probabilities: group of 5 with 2Es, $\frac3{9}\frac2{8}\frac1{7}\frac2{6}\frac1{5}\frac{5!}{3!2!}=1/126$; group of 5 with 1E, $\frac4{9}\frac3{8}\frac2{7}\frac1{6}\frac2{5}\frac{5!}{3!}=8/126$; group of 5 with 0E, $\frac3{9}\frac2{8}\frac1{7}\frac4{6}\frac3{5}\frac{5!}{3!2!}=6/126$; group of 4, $\frac3{9}\frac2{8}\frac1{7}\frac6{6}\frac{4!}{3!}=6/126$. Marks: (B1) two correct probabilities linked with correct scenarios, accepting unsimplified; (M1) four probabilities with denominators including $9\times8\times7\times6\times n$, $n=1$ or 5; (M1) $[1+8+6+6]/126$, probabilities of four correct scenarios added or correct; (A1) $21/126=1/6=0.167$. Total: 4.
